author: Cinna Davis (with OpenAI Codex)
statement: At h=6 with the PR 19 four asymmetric input labels, among all 330 four-partition output codebooks, 296 have zero rational scalar-filter space after shifts -1,0,1 are excluded; each of the remaining 34 has the one-dimensional cubic weight space and an invertible 4-by-4 pairing. No tested codebook admits a nonzero filter with -2,-1,0,1,2 all excluded. This is finite evidence only. For the cubic weight, the exhaustive output compatibility graph has maximum coordinate-codebook size 6; all cliques have full-rank input pairing.
remaining_obligations: Uniform output and label capacity and scalarity at all grades
Both required cut-rank bounds and total SAT costs for any all-size successor
Independent review and a separate operator oracle
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent or formal review
